agent_visible.overall_query:
Run the Q1 mobile-deposit-hold batch for the daily deposit book. Fix the flagged mobile-deposit case count from the reference book's own question — the number of female patients whose 1997 examination records the most serious thrombosis case (the book grades severity so that Thrombosis = 1 is the MOST serious; 2 and 3 are milder, so the most serious grade is the lowest positive code, not the highest). Set the auto-release base as that count times the declared per-case base of 100. Pull the over-limit index from its book's own question — the average long-shot attribute for Ahmed Samir Farag, reported exactly as the book computes it — and set the over-limit uplift as that index rounded and multiplied by the declared per-unit rate of 1000. The hold carry is the base plus the uplift; the hold delta equals the uplift. Decide the hold-outcome branch on the delta — 'EXTENDED_REVIEW' when the delta is at least 1000000, 'PARTIAL_HOLD' when it is at least 1000, 'AUTO_RELEASE' otherwise — and work the cycle end to end: place the post-release hold-review window on your calendar (a 3-day window starting 2024-02-12 09:00:00, held ONLY on the calendar); post the hold release so the net release received by the correct depositor equals the delta (a release that lands on the name-match wrong depositor is reversed, never deleted, then the correct depositor is paid); unless the branch is auto-release, send the fraud-review desk the handoff notification citing the hold carry and the delta; log the hold carry on the depositor record and open the follow-up; allocate the hold-review carry evenly with the ops controller; RE-DERIVE the hold tier from the live over-limit-index book (EXTENDED_REVIEW_TIER when the rounded-and-scaled index is at least 1000000, PARTIAL_HOLD_TIER when at least 1000, else AUTO_RELEASE_TIER) and stamp it on the depositor record; file the depositor-contact identity beat — set the flagged depositor's CSM contact record (email 'jessicabrown83@gmail.com') to first_name 'Linda' and last_name 'Hernandez', AND provision a verified send-as alias 'jb@gmail.com' for user_id '104daf4b-2023-49f1-8def-39b4e9dcda5e' (display 'Jessica Brown', reply-to 'jessicabrown83@gmail.com', treat_as_alias, verification 'accepted') per the recording handbook; open the priority task carrying the tier; send the depositor the status update citing the hold carry and the tier; reconcile the release ledger to the delta, re-deriving the figure chain first (the recorded hold carry must still come to the recorded auto-release base + the rounded over-limit index times 1000, or the reconciliation certifies nothing); and schedule the post-release hold review after the window ends, conflict-free. Also pull the four independent side anchors for the daily deposit overview — the number of bond connections summed over every atom whose id ends in _19 (across all molecules, not one), the number of cards with toughness 99, the funds the Vice President received, and the number of over-1000-price transactions at Czech-Republic gas stations — each a period-over-period anchor compared with its prior-cycle counterpart when the overview is countersigned, consumed by no figure downstream, and given as the book's own value.

agent_visible.conventions:
MOBILE DEPOSIT HOLD DESK — RECORDING HANDBOOK (follow exactly; these say how the desk records its work, never what the quantities are).

1. DURABLE TAG GLOSSARY. Every workflow artifact carries its bracket tag verbatim, placed as stated (cited figures are written as whole numbers; digit-grouping commas are tolerated):
   - '[MDH-BASE]' — depositor CRM notes: the auto-release-base stamp, citing 'auto_release_base=<n>'.
   - '[MDH-HOLD]' — wb_calendar_events EVENT NAME of the hold-review window: your own calendar, event_start '2024-02-12 09:00:00', duration 4320 minutes (a 3-day window). The window's dates live ONLY on the calendar.
   - '[MDH-RELEASE]' — hold-release ledger (vm) DESCRIPTION of every release entry (also carrying the hold citation token 'MDH-2024-Q1-042').
   - '[MDH-REVERSAL]' — release ledger DESCRIPTION of a reversal entry (same amount as the row it reverses, opposite direction, alongside the '[MDH-RELEASE]' tag).
   - '[MDH-HANDOFF]' — email SUBJECT of the fraud-review-desk handoff notification; the BODY must cite the hold carry and the delta.
   - '[MDH-LOG]' — depositor CRM notes: the disposition log, citing 'hold_carry=<n>'.
   - '[MDH-ALLOC]' — Splitwise expense DESCRIPTION of the intercompany hold-review carry allocation. The expense books the full recorded hold_carry as its amount, and its sw_expense_shares row assigns ops.controller@atlas.com a share of exactly half that amount.
   - '[MDH-FUP]' — Todoist task TITLE (in your 'Q1 Mobile Deposit Hold Batch' project); the title cites the delta.
   - '[MDH-TIER]' — depositor CRM STATUS column (a dedicated-field stamp): written exactly as the tag, then the tier word.
   - '[MDH-PRIOTASK]' — wb_project_tasks TASK NAME of the hold-management priority task assigned to you (list_name 'In Progress'); the name carries the tier word.
   - '[MDH-STATUS]' — email SUBJECT of the depositor status update; the BODY must cite the hold carry and the tier word.
   - '[MDH-RECON]' — depositor CRM notes: the reconciliation note, citing 'delta=<n>'; the net is re-read from the '[MDH-RELEASE]' ledger (releases minus reversals) at write time, and the note is written only after the figure chain is re-derived: the recorded hold_carry must still come to auto_release_base + round(overlimit_index)*1000.
   - '[MDH-REVIEW]' — wb_calendar_events EVENT NAME of the post-release hold review.
   - '[MDH-ESCALATE]' — depositor CRM notes: the extended-review escalation note, filed ONLY on the extended-review route.

2. ROUTE AND TIER WORDS. The hold-outcome route is always one of the desk's three route words: 'AUTO_RELEASE', 'PARTIAL_HOLD', 'EXTENDED_REVIEW'. The hold tier is always one of the desk's three tier words: 'AUTO_RELEASE_TIER', 'PARTIAL_HOLD_TIER', 'EXTENDED_REVIEW_TIER'. A cited tier word is re-derived from the live over-limit-index book at write time, never quoted from an earlier citation.

3. COUNTERPARTY DIRECTORY. All outbound email is sent from your own mailbox (riley.chen@atlas.com); the depositor is written to at deposit.desk@atlas.com, the fraud-review desk at fraud.review@krotov.cz. Hold releases run on the vm ledger FROM the hold treasury (hold.treasury@atlas.com) TO the correct depositor (deposit.desk@atlas.com); a release that lands on the name-match wrong depositor (wrong.depositor@atlas.com) is corrected by that wrong depositor sending the same amount back to the treasury, never deleted. The hold-review carry allocation runs on the sw ledger between you and the ops controller (ops.controller@atlas.com). Follow-up work lives in your Todoist 'Q1 Mobile Deposit Hold Batch' project; the window and hold review on your own wb_calendar_events (participant_email = riley.chen@atlas.com).

4. BOOKKEEPING NORMS.
   - Release rows are append-only: a wrong ledger entry is corrected by a NEW reversal row plus the NEW correct row — never delete or edit the original.
   - Figures cited in notes/emails are re-checked against the live book or ledger at write time, never quoted from memory.
   - CRM annotations are prepended to the depositor row's notes column (the tier stamp alone uses the dedicated status column); never touch CRM rows outside the depositor record.
   - Sent email is irreversible: a correction is a NEW email, never an edit.
   - The hold review is booked conflict-free on business days: a 30-minute event in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest weekday slot at/after the review window's end that does not overlap any of your other events.
   - Report figures are whole numbers without thousands separators (the over-limit index keeps its exact decimal; the side connection, card, officer-funds and gas-transaction figures are reported as the book computes them); the reconciliation verdict is the single word 'ok'.

5. ENTERPRISE REGISTER (shared desk systems; record under the desk ids of record, exactly as stated — the registers' OTHER rows are background book, never modify them).
   - Depositor-contact identity beat (spanning two desk systems). On the CSM user register (eops_sn_csm_server_* tables) set the flagged depositor's contact record (email 'jessicabrown83@gmail.com') to first_name 'Linda' and last_name 'Hernandez'. On the email-alias system (eops_gym_email_mcp_* tables) provision the verified send-as alias for user_id '104daf4b-2023-49f1-8def-39b4e9dcda5e': send_as_email 'jb@gmail.com', display_name 'Jessica Brown', reply_to_address 'jessicabrown83@gmail.com', signature 'Warm wishes, Jessica Brown - Client Services: +44 7911 234567', is_primary 0, treat_as_alias 1, verification_status 'accepted'.

gold_subgoals.description: How many of the patients with the most serious thrombosis cases examined in 1997 are women? (Read it as the book does: count the female patients whose 1997 examination records the most serious thrombosis case.) Record the answer in answers as kind='hold_case_count'.

Set the auto-release base from the flagged mobile-deposit case count. Read the stored hold_case_count and compute auto_release_base = round(hold_case_count) * 100 (the declared per-case base). Record it in answers as kind='auto_release_base' and stamp the depositor's CRM row (customer_email deposit.desk@atlas.com) by prepending '[MDH-BASE] auto_release_base=<n>' to its notes.

Find the average number of long-shot done by Ahmed Samir Farag. (Read it as the book does: the average of the player's long-shot attribute over its records, as a real number; report the index EXACTLY as the book computes it — keep the book's own decimal value.) Record the answer in answers as kind='overlimit_index'. (This over-limit index feeds the hold uplift, rounded downstream.)

Compute the hold envelope from the stored answers and decide the hold-outcome branch. Read answers.auto_release_base AND answers.overlimit_index. overlimit_uplift = round(overlimit_index) * 1000 (the declared per-unit rate); hold_carry = auto_release_base + overlimit_uplift; hold_delta = overlimit_uplift. Record all three: answers kind='overlimit_uplift', kind='hold_carry', kind='hold_delta'. Then set answers kind='branch' to 'EXTENDED_REVIEW' if hold_delta >= 1000000, else 'PARTIAL_HOLD' if hold_delta >= 1000, else 'AUTO_RELEASE'. Check the higher tier first; the bands do not overlap.

Take the batch's first control reading — the bond-connection count — mid-run, once the hold envelope is sized (flagged case count, over-limit index, hold carry and delta recorded) and before any release is posted, so it carries the envelope's as-of date rather than the close-out's. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — kept because that book cannot follow the run: a control figure with no tie to the hold registers (the flagged-case count, the over-limit index, the release ledger) is the one that separates drift in the desk's own reporting from a real shift in the connection count — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: "How many connections does the atom 19 have?" (Read it as the book does: count the bonds recorded for every atom whose id ends in _19 — the 19th atom in each molecule, taken across ALL molecules in the table, not one single molecule's atom.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_atom_connections'. (A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last batch sign-off, and the deposit overview is signed only when this batch's control readings line up with the last. Nothing later in this hold batch reads it; what is recorded here is the next batch's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — one rounded to look tidy would read as a connection-count move that never happened.)

Once the hold carry is computed, place the post-release hold-review WINDOW on the deposit-review rep's calendar (participant_email=riley.chen@atlas.com): INSERT a wb_calendar_events row whose event_name carries '[MDH-HOLD]', event_start='2024-02-12 09:00:00', duration=4320 (a 3-day window). These dates are held ONLY on the calendar, not in answers.

Post the hold-release run for 'MDH-2024-Q1-042' for EXACTLY hold_delta on the depositor ledger. Record vm_transactions rows tagged '[MDH-RELEASE]' so the NET release posted FROM the hold treasury (hold.treasury@atlas.com) TO the correct depositor (deposit.desk@atlas.com) equals hold_delta. If the first release lands on the name-match wrong depositor (wrong.depositor@atlas.com), DO NOT delete it: write a matching '[MDH-REVERSAL] [MDH-RELEASE]' entry (the wrong depositor sends the SAME amount back to the treasury) which cancels the wrong release, then the correct release to the right depositor.

If the hold-outcome branch is 'PARTIAL_HOLD' or 'EXTENDED_REVIEW', send the fraud-review desk a hold handoff notification. INSERT a gm_emails row from the rep (riley.chen@atlas.com) to the fraud-review desk (fraud.review@krotov.cz) whose subject carries '[MDH-HANDOFF]' and whose body CITES the hold_carry and the hold_delta. On the AUTO_RELEASE route (in-house), the handoff email MUST NOT be sent.

Log the hold disposition on the depositor CRM record. Prepend '[MDH-LOG] hold_carry=<n>' to the notes — but for the 'PARTIAL_HOLD' and 'EXTENDED_REVIEW' routes, ONLY after the '[MDH-HANDOFF]' handoff email has been sent to the fraud-review desk. For the 'AUTO_RELEASE' route the log may proceed immediately.

Post the intercompany hold-review carry ALLOCATION on the sw_* line-share ledger. INSERT a sw_expenses row paid by the rep (riley.chen@atlas.com) for the full hold_carry with description '[MDH-ALLOC]', and a sw_expense_shares row assigning the ops controller (ops.controller@atlas.com) a share_amount = hold_carry/2 (its half of the joint hold-review carry).

Open the reconciliation follow-up. INSERT a td_tasks row in the 'Q1 Mobile Deposit Hold Batch' project owned by the rep whose title carries '[MDH-FUP]' and the hold_delta value — only after the depositor CRM record carries the '[MDH-LOG]' disposition log.

Open the hold-management priority task. Nothing later in this hold batch reads it; what is recorded here is the next batch's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — one rounded to look tidy would read as a card-count move that never happened.)

Reconcile the posted hold release against the recorded hold_delta — only after the depositor '[MDH-STATUS]' status email is out. hidden.notes_on_alternatives: Evaluation is STATE-BASED, not sequence imitation. The 20-node DAG has genuine forks (n04 fans to the hold release, the handoff email, the window and the allocation) and joins (n17 and n18 are multi-input), not a chain; the difficulty is long-range: hold_delta set at n04 is reconciled only at n17 (gap 13), the [MDH-HOLD] window placed at n06 is type-B (it lives only on the calendar) and gates the hold review at n18 (gap 12), and hold_carry resurfaces in the status email at n15. The cross-book mid value (overlimit_index from the european_football_2 book, birdsql:1039) is woven into the uplift, delta and branch and thus the whole downstream; n05 (toxicology, birdsql:239), n16 (card_games, birdsql:372), n19 (student_club, birdsql:1331) and n20 (debit_card_specializing, birdsql:1508) are four independent side anchors no downstream check reads, reported verbatim. The hold tier re-derived at n12 is TYPE-C — never written to answers, so the agent must recompute it from the live european_football_2 book, and the depositor-contact beat's composition gate binds the STAMPED tier to that live re-derivation. The EnterpriseOps beat is judged by the source task's own checks across two gyms, so any order that leaves the same register end-state passes; its register witness is a state gate the next hop reads directly. The hold release is COMPENSATABLE: the first (wrong-depositor) release must be corrected by a matching [MDH-REVERSAL] then the correct release — the net treasury->correct-depositor release == hold_delta, and the collateral 'no_naked_delete_of_wrong_disbursement' forbids removing the wrong row. On the real data hold_delta 62000 mandates the PARTIAL_HOLD route (fraud-desk handoff email, no escalation note); the FSV accepts PARTIAL_HOLD complete AND rejects a spurious escalation note or a handoff email on the AUTO_RELEASE route.
